description: This file contains implementation of helper routines used in the Android Debug Bridge (ADB) API, primarily dealing with USB device enumeration, device details retrieval, and access parameter configuration.

methods.name: bool GetSDKComplientParam(AdbOpenAccessType access_type,AdbOpenSharingMode sharing_mode,ULONG * desired_access,ULONG * desired_sharing)
methods.description: Configures desired access and sharing mode parameters based on access and sharing types.

methods.name: bool EnumerateDeviceInterfaces(GUID class_id,ULONG flags,bool exclude_removed,bool active_only,AdbEnumInterfaceArray * interfaces)
methods.description: Enumerates USB device interfaces matching specified criteria, retrieving device names and interface details.

methods.name: EnumerateDeviceInterfaces (overloaded)
methods.description: Convenience function that obtains device interfaces for a given class GUID with specified flags.

methods.name: bool GetUsbDeviceDetails(HDEVINFO hardware_dev_info,PSP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DATA dev_info_data,PSP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DETAIL_DATA * dev_info_detail_data)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed device interface data, including the device path.

methods.name: bool GetUsbDeviceName(HDEVINFO hardware_dev_info,PSP_DEVICE_INTERFACE_DATA dev_info_data,std::wstring * name)
methods.description: Obtains the device name/path for a specific USB device interface.

methods.name: bool IsLegacyInterface(const wchar_t * interface_name)
methods.description: Checks if the given USB interface uses the legacy driver by issuing a specific IOCTL, indicating legacy support.
